entities.summary: Joseph Süß Oppenheimer was a German banker who was court Jew for Charles Alexander, Duke of Württemberg, managing several of his enterprises. Throughout his career, Oppenheimer made scores of powerful enemies, some of whom conspired against him, leading to his arrest and execution after Charles Alexander's death.
